headlines.title: 중동 불안 에 유류세 인하 9월까지 연장 … 석유 최고가격제도 유지

top5_headlines.title: '꼼수 관세' 꺼낸 트럼프 , 강제노동 관세 60개 국 부과...한국 12.5%
top5_headlines.summary: 도널드 트럼프 미국 행정부가 한국을 포함한 전 세계 60개 교역국을 상대로 최고 12.5%에 달하는 무역법 301조 강제노동 관세를 부과한다. 한국도 사실상 12.5%의 관세를 맞았다. 로이터 통신은 23일(현지시간) 복수의 백악관 고위 당국자를 인용해 오는 24일 0시01분부터 60개 교역국에서 수입되는 물품에 대해 10~12.

top5_headlines.title: 3분기 공적채권 67조원 발행 …" 채권 수요 다소 회복 "
top5_headlines.summary: 재경부, 채권 발행기관 협의체 회의 재정경제부 청사 [촬영 김주성] 정부세종청사 내 재정경제부 청사. 2026.1.6 (세중=연합뉴스) 안채원 기자 = 정부가 3분기 국고채를 제외한 주요 공적채권을 67조원 규모로 발행한다. 정책 수요 증가로 당초 계획보다 4조원 늘어난 규모다.

top5_headlines.title: 美, 韓 '환율관찰대상국' 유지 "원화약세, 경제체력 대비 과도"
top5_headlines.summary: 美 재무부, 환율 보고서 中日 등 10개국 리스트에 올려 달러당 원화값 1460원대 복귀 미국 행정부가 한국을 4회 연속 환율 관찰대상국으로 지정했다. 다만 미국 재무부는 한국 외환당국이 원화 약세를 막기 위해 달러를 순매도한 사실을 인정하며, 최근 원화 약세가 한국 경제의 강한 기초체력에 부합하지 않는다고 평가했다.

top5_headlines.title: [단독] 월세 가격까지 치솟자…정부, 월세 세액공제 혜택 늘린다
top5_headlines.summary: 서울 강남구 한 부동산 중개업소 [연합뉴스] 부동산 시장에서 월세가격이 지속적으로 오르자 정부가 월세 세액공제 혜택을 더욱 늘리기로 했다. 임차인의 주거비 부담을 일부나마 완화해주기 위해서다. 24일 정부 관계자에 따르면 재정경제부는 8월 초 발표할 예정인 세법개정안에 월세 세액공제 혜택을 확대하는 방안을 담을 계획이다.

key_headlines.title: Trump Administration Imposes 12.5% Forced Labor Tariffs on South Korea
key_headlines.summary: The Trump administration has imposed Section 301 forced labor tariffs of up to 12.5% on South Korea and 60 other trading partners, replacing the previous 10% global tariffs. Major export sectors including semiconductors, automobiles, and steel have been exempted from these tariffs.

key_headlines.title: U.S. Maintains South Korea on Currency Surveillance List Despite Acknowledging Won Weakness
key_headlines.summary: The U.S. Treasury Department has designated South Korea as a currency surveillance country for the fourth consecutive time, though acknowledging that recent won weakness is not warranted given Korea's strong economic fundamentals. The won has strengthened to around 1,460 per dollar.

key_headlines.title: South Korea Expands Monthly Rent Tax Credits as Rental Prices Surge
key_headlines.summary: The government plans to expand monthly rent tax credit benefits in an August tax reform proposal to help ease housing cost burdens as rental prices continue to rise across the country. This measure aims to provide relief to renters facing increased housing expenses.

key_headlines.title: KOSPI and KOSDAQ Plummet Amid Middle East Geopolitical Risks and Surging Oil Prices
key_headlines.summary: Domestic stock markets experienced sharp declines exceeding 5% as international oil prices surged due to Middle East geopolitical tensions, triggering inflation concerns and foreign investor selloffs. Circuit breakers were activated multiple times with volatility indices reaching levels not seen since the COVID-19 pandemic.

key_headlines.title: Naver, Nvidia, and Brookfield to Invest $10 Billion in Korean AI Infrastructure
key_headlines.summary: A major strategic partnership announced involving significant capital commitment to develop AI data centers and infrastructure in South Korea. Brookfield currently manages approximately $120 billion in assets in Korea across infrastructure, real estate, and energy sectors.

sections.Hot Economy News: South Korea faces multiple economic headwinds as Trump's administration imposed 12.5% forced labor tariffs affecting 60 trading nations, with semiconductors, automobiles, and steel exempted. Simultaneously, the government announced a 67 trillion won public bond issuance for Q3, increased by 4 trillion won due to rising policy demand. The government is implementing emergency measures to combat inflation through oil price controls, maintaining fuel tax cuts, and investing 350 billion won in food supply stabilization including egg and mackerel imports. Monthly rent tax credit benefits are being expanded to address surging rental prices across the nation. Despite economic challenges, the government remains focused on supporting both macro-fiscal stability and consumer welfare amid global uncertainties.
sections.Macro & Fiscal Policy: South Korea's economic outlook shows mixed signals with the government planning a 67 trillion won public bond issuance in Q3, exceeding initial forecasts by 4 trillion won due to increased policy demand. Consumer sentiment is expected to improve for three consecutive months supported by strong semiconductor exports and a 3.7% GDP growth surprise in Q2, though real gross national income surged 15.6% year-on-year, significantly outpacing GDP growth. The central bank faces inflation pressures from international oil price spikes, prompting continued emergency pricing controls on petroleum products. Officials acknowledge a structural shift in Korea's economic trajectory toward higher growth potential of 2.5-3%, departing from the previous 1.5-2% trend growth rate.
sections.Financial Markets: Domestic stock markets experienced severe volatility with KOSPI declining over 5% and KOSDAQ following suit as Middle East geopolitical tensions drove international crude prices higher, triggering inflation concerns. Circuit breakers activated 41 times through July 25, with VKOSPI volatility indices reaching 80-level ranges rivaling COVID-19 pandemic peaks. U.S. Treasury yields jumped to 4.7%, their highest in 18 months, pressuring Korean markets as investors reassess risk-reward dynamics. Market participants debate whether current valuations represent genuine buying opportunities or signals of fundamental deterioration, with earnings-to-price ratios and risk aversion metrics sending conflicting signals about equity valuations.
sections.Industry & Technology: South Korea's semiconductor sector continues gaining strength with major Korean chipmakers poised to benefit from global AI infrastructure buildout, despite facing 12.5% U.S. tariffs on products not specifically exempted. China's CATL reported a 42% profit increase in H1 2026 despite electric vehicle battery sales slowdown, primarily driven by booming energy storage system demand. Korean automotive, shipbuilding, and battery industries are accumulating massive industrial datasets to advance AI-driven manufacturing optimization and autonomous production technologies. The government evaluates semiconductor production capacity expansion while assessing supply chain resilience to U.S. trade policy uncertainties and tariff implementations.
sections.Real Estate: Real estate markets remain under pressure as government implements policies to moderate price increases, particularly expanding monthly rent tax credits to address surging rental expenses. Apartment purchase restrictions limiting mortgages to 600 million won for properties under 1.5 billion won have diverted buyer demand to outer Seoul areas, with 62% of transactions now concentrated in properties above 900 million won. Consecutive price increases in KOSPI apartment indices continue for 76 weeks at modest growth rates around 0.27% weekly, as potential homebuyers reassess affordability amid rising interest rate expectations and mortgage burdens. Households face mounting mortgage obligations as base rates continue climbing, with some borrowers considering abandoning homeownership plans due to unsustainable debt service costs.
sections.International Economy: Trump's forced labor tariff implementation against 60 trading nations at rates between 10-12.5% marks a shift from global tariffs, with South Korea facing 12.5% and Japan expressing regret over similar treatment despite complying with international trade norms. The U.S. administration threatened retaliatory tariffs against the EU in response to antitrust penalties against American tech companies, signaling escalating global trade tensions. U.S. employment data surprised to the upside amid oil price shocks, with weekly jobless claims reaching 1969-record lows, increasing probability of September Fed rate increases to 82% versus June expectations. Samsung and LG face critical strategic decisions regarding global production base allocations between domestic Korea operations and Vietnam-Mexico facilities to optimize tariff exposure and supply chain efficiency.
sections.AI & Economy: South Korea is positioning itself as a global AI infrastructure hub, with Naver, Nvidia, and Brookfield announcing a $10 billion investment commitment focused on data centers, computing resources, and energy infrastructure. President Lee met with Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei to expand AI investment and cooperation, signaling elevated government priority for attracting AI capital and expertise. Naver is launching its 'AI Factory' business to capitalize on computation resource scarcity, aiming to rent computing capacity as big tech companies face severe chip and infrastructure shortages. Major Korean conglomerates including SK and Samsung are leveraging semiconductor leadership and manufacturing expertise to participate in the global AI infrastructure race, with industry assessments suggesting this represents Korea's golden opportunity for next-generation growth.
sections.Others: SK Group's chairman emphasized mega-projects as essential for Korean long-term growth while announcing strategic partnership with Nvidia to develop next-generation AI infrastructure. Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang validated Korea's competitive advantages in global-class networks, data centers, and semiconductor technology leadership, particularly through partnerships with SK Telecom and SK Hynix. Regulatory authorities accelerated margin requirements for single-stock Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix leveraged ETFs from their original timeline to July 31, requiring 30 million won minimum account balances. President Lee advanced government diplomacy with American political and business leaders to address bilateral trade disputes and the Coupang controversy while building support for expanded Korean AI investment and cooperation initiatives.
